name: grok-build-unofficial
description: Claude Code-style chat UI for the Grok Build CLI over the Agent Client Protocol. Unofficial — not affiliated with xAI.

commands.title: Grok Build: Add Selection to Chat

grokBuild.cliPath.description: Path to the grok executable. Leave as "grok" to use PATH.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every file write and terminal command.
Apply file edits automatically, still ask before terminal commands.
Read-only research; the agent proposes a plan and touches nothing.
Never ask. The agent writes files and runs commands unattended.
grokBuild.permissionMode.description: Approval mode enforced by this extension at the fs/terminal callback boundary. Grok's own permission machinery is not used (it does not raise permission requests over ACP).

grokBuild.model.description: Model id to launch with (e.g. grok-4.5). Empty uses the CLI default.

grokBuild.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort to launch with. Empty uses the CLI default.

enumDescriptions: Always use the dark Grok Build palette.
Always use the light Grok Build palette.
Follow the VS Code color theme kind (light or dark) without sampling VS Code colours.
grokBuild.theme.description: Webview colour theme. The webview owns its own palette and does not inherit VS Code theme tokens.

grokBuild.showThinking.description: Stream the agent's reasoning into the transcript (collapsed by default).

grokBuild.autoExpandThinking.description: Expand thinking blocks as they stream instead of keeping them collapsed.

grokBuild.readUnsavedBuffers.description: Serve fs/read_text_file from unsaved editor buffers so the agent sees exactly what you see.

grokBuild.applyEditsAsWorkspaceEdit.description: Apply agent writes through the VS Code edit API (native undo, dirty buffers) instead of writing straight to disk.

grokBuild.useSharedLeader.description: Attach to grok's shared leader process so sessions stay in sync with the TUI. Disable to spawn a private backend.

grokBuild.terminalOutputByteLimit.description: Maximum bytes of command output handed back to the agent per terminal.

grokBuild.logProtocol.description: Write every JSON-RPC frame to the Grok Build output channel. Secrets are redacted.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.mjs --production && vsce package --no-dependencies
